Question
========
What is the purpose of describing research data limitations in a DMP?

Answerlist
----------
* To justify incomplete datasets and/or missing values
* To escape legal responsibility in case of a lawsuit
* To clarify factors that may affect data reuse
* To prevent data from being used by competitors


Solution
========
Research data limitations are described to clarify factors that may affect data reuse.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* False
